claims: Coinbase states 2026 priorities are the everything exchange, stablecoins/payments, and onchain adoption
Q3 net revenue approximately $1.2B; transaction revenue $590.2M; subscription and services revenue $570.2M
Q3 stablecoin revenue $306.905M; nine-month stablecoin revenue $904.487M

Q3 consumer and institutional crypto spot volume declined 59% and 53% year over year

Q3 net income $718.7M; operating income $61.669M; $715.022M gain on crypto assets held for investment, primarily fair-value remeasurement of Bitcoin and Ethereum

stablecoin revenue is not XRP-specific revenue
aggregate collateral and borrowed-asset balances are not XRP-specific
net income is materially affected by fair-value gains on long-term crypto investments
